headline: Novo Nordisk Lifts Guidance on Strong Wegovy Pill Uptake
summary: Novo Nordisk raised its corporate guidance following strong customer uptake of its newly launched weight-loss pill, boosting investor sentiment and driving its stock higher.
why: Novo Nordisk is a major global pharmaceutical company known for its diabetes and obesity treatments. Guidance revisions by large-cap pharmaceutical leaders directly impact investor expectations and sector valuations.

impacts.name: Novo Nordisk
impacts.why: The company's stock jumped higher after it lifted its guidance.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
